Finding.description: One review finding. Its schema is generated into `prompts/verdict.schema.json`.

line.description: Required; `null` when the finding has no line, otherwise 1 or more.

open.description: True while the finding blocks the merge.

description:
The body of `dvb run verdict`. The engine adds head, pr, model, vendor and
role from its own record of the run; a body that fails this schema is not a verdict.

examples.summary: Reviewed the diff; cargo test and clippy ran clean.

findings.detail: Check the task is not stopped in the same transaction before sending.
findings.title: Push happens before the stopped check

summary.description: What was reviewed and what was run. In a project without CI, say which local gates ran.
